Quick overview
FAQ
Find answers to common questions about M Plan tiers, usage, Subscription Keys, and usage rules.
Which M Plan tiers are available?
The available subscription tiers are Go, Explore, and Build.
Tier | Intended usage | Usage relative to Go
Go | Getting started | 1x (baseline)
Explore | Everyday use | 3x
Build | Intensive use | 7.5x
Do I need a separate subscription or API Key to use MiniMax Code?
No. After subscribing to M Plan, sign in to MiniMax Code to get your member benefits. No separate subscription or Subscription Key is needed. You only need a Subscription Key to use M Plan in other AI tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.
How can I check M Plan usage?
You can check M Plan usage in three ways: Method 1: Visit the usage page Visit the usage page to view your plan, usage limits, Credits, and usage history. Method 2: Use MiniMax CLI
mmx quota
Method 3: Use the API endpoint
curl --location 'https://www.minimax.io/v1/token_plan/remains' \ --header 'Authorization: Bearer <API Key>' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json'
